svg.title: Settings — large — light (Windows)
svg.desc: Settings master–detail, large (1200–1599dp) laptop on Windows, light theme, pointer density. Storage and offline section: StorageUsageBar, value and destructive tiles, downloaded papers list (hover row, keyboard focus on a Remove button).
